facts.text: Audrey has a tattoo of her four dogs on her arm.

evidence.quote: Hey Andrew, since we last spoke I got another tattoo of my four dogs on my arm!

facts.text: Audrey has four dogs that she considers to be a significant part of her life.

evidence.quote: They really mean a lot to me so I thought it'd be nice to have them with me wherever I go.
I took them all to the vet and got them checked up, it was such a havoc that next time I'll bring them one by one.

facts.text: Audrey's four dogs each have a favorite spot to relax.

evidence.quote: They each have their favorite spot to chill. Pepper loves lounging on the couch, Pixie always curls up in her bed, Precious has her chair, and Panda loves to relax on his rug!
